title: ts_guess scan_prepare (gaussian) silently writes charge 0, nprocshared=4 and a relative chk; charge/multiplicity args are rejected
body: Repro: ts_guess(mode='scan_prepare', engine='gaussian', input_path=<charged 15-atom +1 xyz>, scans=[{coord_type:'bond', atoms:[6,4], scan_end:1.50, scan_steps:14}], method='B3LYP', basis_set='def2SVP', keywords='EmpiricalDispersion=GD3BJ Int(UltraFine) SCF=Tight SCRF=(CPCM,Solvent=Water)', output_path=<abs>.gjf). Passing charge:1 / multiplicity:1 is rejected ('field is not accepted here' / 'invalid value'). Written input has '0 1' instead of '1 1', %nprocshared=4 with no %mem, and %chk=scan.chk (relative). Route and scan line are correct. Impact: any charged system scanned this way is silently neutralised, so the whole scan and the TS guess derived from it are invalid while the log looks normal. Local fix applied by the reporting session: edit the first 8 lines to %nprocshared=8 / %mem=10000MB / absolute %chk / '1 1' (sha 5e38fb35... -> b784f4b6...), verified by re-reading the header and re-measuring d(Owater-Ccarbonyl)=2.900 A and d(H10-Ocarbonyl)=1.720 A. Suggested fix: accept charge/multiplicity (or inherit from the source components), honour nproc/mem, default chk to an absolute path in the output directory, and error out rather than defaulting charge to 0. Full write-up: gold_finish_20261015/ISSUE_196_SCAN_PREPARE_CHARGE_DEFAULTS.md
